title: Network Programming – Out-of-Band Data
subtopics: sending OOB data with MSG_OOB flag
receiving OOB data: select(), SIGURG, SO_OOBINLINE

definitions.definition: Out-of-band data – priority data sent separately from the normal data stream
TCP header flag indicating urgent data is present
Flag used with send() to send out-of-band data
Signal delivered to a process when urgent (OOB) data arrives
Socket option that places OOB data inline with normal data

learning_objectives: Explain the concept and use of TCP out-of-band data
Implement sending and receiving of OOB data using select(), SIGURG, and SO_OOBINLINE
